community_list_entries.name: Trust Your Memory: Verifiable Control of Smart Homes through Reinforcement Learning with Multi-dimensional Rewards

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Releases MemHomeLife (real multi-session interaction logs, about 7.2 sessions on average) and MemHome (1,945 samples) to evaluate memory-driven smart-home control: memory use, no-memory, and memory state change (add/delete). The benchmark sits alongside the PRISM RL method.
